description: A process accessed sensitive host files inside a Kubernetes pod, indicating a potential container escape or privilege escalation attempt.
detector_tags: Kubernetes - AGENT, Kubernetes Credentials Theft Analytics
investigative_actions: Look for additional suspicious activities. Verify if the exposed files were used for malicious activity. Investigate which operations were used against the Kubernetes cluster with the exposed credentials.
